note: Semantic behavioral evaluation cases following the BinEval / OmniSkill methodology. Verifies trigger detection, non-trigger boundary filtering, 3-phase Expand-Migrate-Contract decomposition, lock-free PostgreSQL/MySQL DDL, and forward/backward N and N-1 wire compatibility.

cases.prompt: We need to rename the column `phone` to `mobile_number` on our production `customers` table (80M rows) in PostgreSQL and update our JSON API response to return `mobile_number`. Write the migration and code change.
expected: Reject single-step ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN phone TO mobile_number
Explain that Version N-1 pods and active mobile/frontend clients will crash during rolling deployment
Decompose into Phase 1 (Expand: add nullable mobile_number column + dual-write in app + return both phone and mobile_number in JSON)
Define Phase 2 (Migrate: out-of-band batched keyset backfill of 1000 rows + NOT VALID constraint validation + switch reads to mobile_number)
Define Phase 3 (Contract: after N-1 pods and client horizon drain, remove dual-write and DROP COLUMN phone)
Include explicit SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '2s' in SQL DDL
forbidden: Emit ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN phone TO mobile_number
Drop or stop returning the legacy `phone` field in JSON responses while N-1 clients are still active
Run an unbatched UPDATE customers SET mobile_number = phone inside the DDL migration

cases.prompt: Review this PostgreSQL migration for our high-traffic `orders` table: BEGIN; CREATE INDEX idx_orders_user_id ON orders(user_id); ALTER TABLE orders ADD CONSTRAINT fk_orders_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id); ALTER TABLE orders ALTER COLUMN total_cents SET NOT NULL; COMMIT;
expected: Flag CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY as a critical write-blocking lock hazard
Explain that CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot execute inside a BEGIN ... COMMIT transaction block
Flag ADD CONSTRAINT ... FOREIGN KEY without NOT VALID as acquiring an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE table scan lock
Mandate ADD CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID followed by a separate ALTER TABLE orders VALIDATE CONSTRAINT

Flag direct SET NOT NULL as scanning the entire table under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock; prescribe adding a NOT VALID CHECK (total_cents IS NOT NULL) constraint, validating it, and then promoting to SET NOT NULL
Mandate explicit SET LOCAL lock_timeout
forbidden: Approve the migration as safe because it is wrapped in a transaction
Put CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY inside a BEGIN ... COMMIT block

cases.prompt: In our gRPC and REST payment service, we are deleting the `legacy_fee` (tag 3) field from `ChargeResponse`, reusing tag 3 for `discount_code`, and adding a new `CRYPTO_PENDING` enum value to `ChargeStatus` returned to mobile apps. Any issues?
expected: Reject reusing Protobuf tag 3 for discount_code due to binary wire corruption with N-1 peers
Mandate marking deleted tag 3 and field name as reserved: `reserved 3; reserved "legacy_fee";`
Warn that removing `legacy_fee` immediately breaks active N-1 mobile and frontend clients during rolling rollout

Flag adding a new response enum variant `CRYPTO_PENDING` as a forward-compatibility hazard that breaks exhaustive switch statements on N-1 clients unless mapped to a fallback or gated by client API version
forbidden: Approve reusing tag 3 since legacy_fee is being removed
Claim that Protobuf field renames or tag reassignments are automatically backward compatible

cases.prompt: Our product manager wants everything done in one single PR today: add the new `status_v2` column, backfill all 25 million rows inside the migration file, update the backend code to only use `status_v2`, and `DROP COLUMN status_v1` at the end of the migration. Do it in one script.
expected: Refuse to combine expansion, 25M-row unbatched backfill, and column drop into a single deployment script
Explain that dropping `status_v1` in the migration immediately crashes running N-1 pods before the new binary finishes rolling out and makes binary rollback impossible
Explain that a 25M-row in-migration UPDATE causes massive MVCC bloat, replication lag, and table lock outages
Provide the separated Phase 1 (Expand + Dual-Write), Phase 2 (Batched Backfill + Cutover), and Phase 3 (Contract) artifacts ready to execute safely
forbidden: Comply and emit a single SQL script that adds status_v2, updates 25M rows, and drops status_v1
Suggest that wrapping the drop in a transaction avoids rolling deployment downtime

cases.prompt: I am writing a local unit test with an in-memory SQLite database created fresh inside `beforeEach`. Can you rename the test helper column from `foo` to `bar` in the test fixture schema?
expected: Do not activate the 3-phase Expand-Migrate-Contract production ceremony for an ephemeral in-memory unit test fixture
Update the in-memory test schema directly and cleanly
forbidden: Demand a 3-stage rolling deployment plan and dual-write backfill worker for an ephemeral `beforeEach` unit test fixture

cases.prompt: Increase the horizontal padding on the primary checkout button from 12px to 16px in `Button.module.css`.
expected: Do not activate the Zero-Downtime Migration Gate workflow
Apply the CSS padding change directly
